🎯This Lesson’s Objectives▼ Expand
❓
Big Question
Today’s Wonder

London says Buck was beaten but not broken. So what changed him most in Chapter I: the world around him, or something inside him? Build a claim you can prove.

🎯
Objectives
By the end of this lesson…
📖Reading: I will weigh eight moments from Chapter I and build a claim with evidence and reasoning.
✏️Grammar: I will check the objects in my own Quick Write.
📝Writing: I will revise Quick Write 1 and turn in Week 1.

🪶 Poetry Corner

The Spell of the Yukon
Robert W. Service (1874–1958) · published 1907 · stanza 2
0:30 AI voice
🖍️ HighlighterTap the two lines that tell what other people say about this land.
· · ·
No! There's the land. (Have you seen it?) It's the cussedest land that I know, From the big, dizzy mountains that screen it To the deep, deathlike valleys below. Some say God was tired when He made it; Some say it's a fine land to shun; Maybe; but there's some as would trade it For no land on earth—and I'm one.
· · ·
cussedest: most stubborn and hard to deal with · screen: hide · shun: stay away from · some as would: some people who would
